headline: Langgam Fikir Enterprise announces the third edition of Paulus: Perosak Risalah al-Masīḥ
subhead: The Malay-language study of Pauline theology returns with a revised grammar audit and an expanded apparatus of sources.
summary: Langgam Fikir Enterprise will publish a third edition of its Malay-language study of Paul of Tarsus, revised throughout against the Tatabahasa Dewan standard and expanded with additional primary sources.
body: Langgam Fikir Enterprise today announced a third edition of *Paulus: Perosak Risalah al-Masīḥ*, the Malay-language study of Pauline theology first issued in 2025. The new edition carries a full grammar audit against the third edition of Tatabahasa Dewan, together with an expanded apparatus of primary sources.
The revision responds to reader correspondence received since the second printing, and standardises transliteration of Arabic terms throughout. An English companion volume remains in development.
The third edition will be distributed through the imprint's usual channels. Review copies are available to academic and religious-studies press on request.

quotes.text: The argument has not changed. What has changed is the evidence a reader can check without leaving the page.
quotes.attribution: Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi, publisher, Langgam Fikir Enterprise

boilerplate: Langgam Fikir Enterprise is an independent imprint based in Seri Kembangan, Selangor, publishing in literature, history, ideas and religious discourse.
